Package com.neueda.leap.reporting.clients

Class ClientController

java.lang.Object
com.neueda.leap.reporting.clients.ClientController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/reports/clients") @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole(\'ANALYST\', \'OPERATIONS\')") public class ClientController extends Object
Clients page API (TS-18.5): trading accounts with their holdings and filled orders, from the reporting dataset the Reports page also reads. Accounts carry their owner's name and email; responses never include the owning user's id.

    • list

      @GetMapping public ClientDtos.Page<ClientDtos.ClientSummary> list(@RequestParam(required=false) String search, @RequestParam(required=false) String level, @RequestParam(required=false) String status, @RequestParam(required=false) String sort, @RequestParam(defaultValue="0") @Min(0L) @jakarta.validation.constraints.Min(0L) int page, @RequestParam(defaultValue="25") @Min(1L) @Max(100L) @jakarta.validation.constraints.Min(1L) @jakarta.validation.constraints.Max(100L) int size)
      Lists trading accounts.
      Parameters:
      search - part of an account number or name, a client's name or email, or a full account or order ID
      level - NOVICE or ADVANCED
      status - PENDING, ACTIVE, BLOCKED or CLOSED
      sort - key or key,asc|desc
      page - zero-based page number
      size - page size, 1 to 100
      Returns:
      one page of accounts
